scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
Hm...after several days of observation, this place seems to be a device imprinted with the memories of an airship.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 雷恩]
嗯...观察了好几天，这里似乎是个记录着飞空艇记忆的装置。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
...that is different. I don't have any more information...
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 雷恩]
...这倒有些不同。
我也没有更多线索了...

scripts.translation: 使用装置

scripts.text: An unknown error has occurred.
scripts.translation: 发生未知错误。

scripts.text:
[Loki]
...Glad there aren't any of those pesky things here...
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
...还好这里没有那些讨厌的家伙...

scripts.text:
[Loki]
...I will defend this place no matter what. Go down into the airship...!!
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
...这里我会守住，你们下到飞空艇下层去...！！

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
Flying in the air through with the strength of machinery... the development of technology is truly marvelous.
scripts.translation:
[芬里尔]
靠机械的力量就能飞上天...技术的发展真是了不起。

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
But I feel there's a power of some kind... I think this airship won't be able to fly solely just by technology.
scripts.translation:
[芬里尔]
但我感觉到有别的力量...这艘飞空艇应该不只是靠技术飞行的。

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
I will face them here. Chaos, go down to the lower floor of the airship with Iris!
scripts.translation:
[芬里尔]
这里交给我。
混沌，你和艾莉丝到飞空艇下层去！

scripts.text:
[Iris]
Whoa~ this is great!! The wind is so cool~!!
Hooray~ we are flying through the sky! For free on top of that!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
哇~太棒了！！风好凉爽~！！
万岁~我们在天空中飞翔！而且还是免费的！

scripts.text:
[Iris]
Is it not marvelous how this huge ship can fly without the use of magic? Chaos?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
这么大的船，不用魔法就能飞上天，真神奇啊！你说是不是，混沌？

scripts.text:
[Iris]
...?? Chaos?

[Chaos]
.....Sage Kadmon..
scripts.translation:
[混沌]
...贤者 卡德蒙...

scripts.text:
[Iris]
What are you doing instead of listening to me!!!!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
我在跟你说话，你到底在干什么啊！！

scripts.text:
[Chaos]
Argh! Aaah~!!
scripts.translation:
[混沌]
啊！啊啊~！！

scripts.text:
[Iris]
Humph! That's what you get for being absent-minded!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
哼！活该，谁让你走神了！

scripts.text:
[Chaos]
Ah...Iris!! Are you trying to kill me~!!
scripts.translation:
[混沌]
啊...艾莉丝！！你想杀了我吗~！！

scripts.text:
[Iris]
Humph! I don't care if you die or not...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
哼！你死不死我才不在乎...

scripts.text:
[Captain Ferlock]
Hey!! No horsing around on the ship!!
This is what's wrong with young humans. They have no manners! If you act up I will toss all of you off!!
scripts.translation:
[船长 费尔洛克]
喂！！不许在船上打闹！！
现在的年轻人类就是这样，一点规矩都不懂！再闹就把你们全扔下去！！

scripts.text:
[Iris]
Oops... By the way captain, how does this big airship fly through the sky? It is so marvelous!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
哎呀...对了，船长，这么大的飞空艇到底是怎么飞起来的？真神奇啊！

scripts.text:
[Captain Ferlock]
Huh? That's a good question.
As you can see, we heat the large boiler to boil water then use the pressure of the steam to move the pistons which turns the cogwheel and moves the turbine to turn the propeller.
scripts.translation:
[船长 费尔洛克]
嗯？问得好。
正如你所见，我们加热巨大的锅炉把水烧开，利用蒸汽的压力推动活塞，带动齿轮转动涡轮，从而驱动螺旋桨。

scripts.text:
[Iris]
Eh... So that's how this big ship floats... but now the feeling of the mystery is gone. I thought there would be some mystical device... a little disappointed...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
呃...原来这么大的船就是这样飞起来的啊...一点神秘感都没了。
我还以为有什么神奇的装置呢...有点失望...

scripts.text:
[Captain Ferlock]
That's right. This big ship can't be in the sky with just steam. So it uses an amplifier called a 'Rune Engine'.
scripts.translation:
[船长 费尔洛克]
那倒也是，光靠蒸汽，这么大的船可飞不起来。
所以还得靠一种叫“符文引擎”的增幅装置。

scripts.text:
[Iris]
Rune Engine? What is that?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
符文引擎？那是什么？

scripts.text:
[Captain Ferlock]
It's a device that uses a magical stone.
Something about fallen fragments of a broken heart according to the legends... a ridiculous legend but that doesn't matter...
scripts.translation:
[船长 费尔洛克]
它是一种利用魔法石的装置。
传说那是破碎之心的碎片...虽然是个荒谬的传说，但这并不重要...

scripts.text:
[Captain Ferlock]
The stone is the so-called 'Tear of Ymir.' If put in junction with locomotive engines like steam engines, the rune exuded from the stone amplifies the energy.
scripts.translation:
[船长 费尔洛克]
那块石头叫“尤弥尔的泪滴”。
把它和蒸汽机之类的动力机械连接起来，石头释放的符文就能增强动力。

scripts.text:
[Captain Ferlock]
In all honesty it is not an overstatement to say a rock the size of a thumb is moving this ship. It possesses an incredible power.
scripts.translation:
[船长 费尔洛克]
说真的，这艘船全靠一块拇指大小的石头驱动，这话一点也不夸张。
它蕴含着惊人的力量。

scripts.text:
[Iris]
That little thing...!!!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
就这么一小块...！！！

scripts.text:
[Loki]
......huh?
Something is coming this way...
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
...嗯？
有什么东西正朝这边过来...

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Alert!! Alert!! A large Wyvern unit at 7 o'clock!!
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
警报！！警报！！7点钟方向发现大量双足飞龙！！

scripts.text:
[Captain Ferlock]
What?!
scripts.translation:
[船长 费尔洛克]
什么？！

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Gre...Gremlins!! Gremlins have landed from the Wyvern!!
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
小...小鬼！！小鬼从双足飞龙上降落了！！

scripts.text:
[Chaos]
Hm... What is this now?
scripts.translation:
[混沌]
嗯...这是什么情况？

scripts.text:
[Arcana]
Hahahaha~ You have waited long!!
Beautiful sorceress Arcana's surprise airborne monster show!!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔卡纳]
哈哈哈哈~让各位久等了！！
美丽魔女阿尔卡纳的空中魔物突袭秀，正式登场！！

scripts.text:
[Chaos]
Wha...what show?
scripts.translation:
[混沌]
什...什么表演？

scripts.text:
[Arcana]
Now... Let us get started! Gremlins~!!
It's PARTY TIME~!!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔卡纳]
好了...让我们开始吧！小鬼们~！！
派对时间到~！！

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Cap..Captain! This is serious!
Gremlins are all over the ship!!
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
船...船长！情况很严重！
小鬼们已经遍布整艘飞空艇了！！

scripts.text:
[Captain Ferlock]
What?! These are Gremlins?!
You bastards!! Come down from there now!!
scripts.translation:
[船长 费尔洛克]
什么？！这些是小鬼？！
你们这群混蛋！！快从上面下来！！

scripts.text:
[Iris]
Captain. There is no need to be so agitated.
Gremlins are just monsters that tinker with machines. Rather...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
船长，别这么激动嘛。
小鬼不就是些喜欢捣鼓机器的魔物吗？倒是...

scripts.text:
[Captain Ferlock]
You don't know what you're talking about!!
We're at an altitude of 8000!! Even a minor malfunction could lead to a deadly crash!
scripts.translation:
[船长 费尔洛克]
你懂什么！！
我们可是在8000高空！哪怕出一点小故障，都可能机毁人亡！

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Argh!! Rear engine number 1!!
...This is serious! They are heading towards the engine room! We have to protect the Rune Engine!!
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
啊！！1号后引擎！！
...情况很严重！它们正朝引擎室冲去！我们必须保护符文引擎！！

scripts.text:
[Captain Ferlock]
Damn it... Where did I put my weapon...
Hey humans!! Block that nuisance while I go to the captain's room to look for my weapon!!
scripts.translation:
[船长 费尔洛克]
该死...我把武器放哪了...
喂，人类！！你们先挡住这些麻烦的家伙，我去船长室找武器！！

scripts.text:
[Captain Ferlock]
We have to especially stop them from getting to the Rune Engine!! If that is destroyed the ship can no longer fly!!
scripts.translation:
[船长 费尔洛克]
尤其不能让它们靠近符文引擎！！引擎一毁，船就飞不起来了！！

scripts.text:
[Captain Ferlock]
Damn... if only I had my weapon...
scripts.translation:
[船长 费尔洛克]
该死...要是我有武器就好了...

scripts.text:
[Chaos]
Iris!! Let's go down to the engine room! Loki and Fenrir, hold this place!
scripts.translation:
[混沌]
艾莉丝！！我们去引擎室！洛基和芬里尔，守住这里！

scripts.text:
[Iris]
Oh...okay! Alright... Let's go!!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
啊...好！我们走！！

scripts.text:
[Traveling Knight]
What are these things?
Should I cut them all down? ...No it is not enough money for me to be involved...
scripts.translation:
[游历的骑士]
这些是什么东西？
要不要全砍了？...不，这点钱可不值得我掺和...

scripts.text:
[Passed out Drunkard]
Ugh... Getting drunk... hiccup
....Snore...Zzz

[Wealthy man at a meal]
Wha... what are these monsters?!
How dare you interrupt my precious meal time! Guard! Where are you!
scripts.translation:
[用餐的富人]
什...什么魔物？！
竟敢打扰我宝贵的用餐时间！卫兵！你们在哪！

scripts.text:
[Free Riding Bard]
Whoa... Gorgeous~ Fantastic~
Even the exploding ship is incredible~ Whoa~
scripts.translation:
[搭便车的诗人]
哇...好壮观~ 太精彩了~
连飞空艇爆炸都这么不可思议~ 哇~

scripts.text:
[Airship Cafeteria Manager]
They might look menacing but those monsters are also customers to my cafeteria.
What would you like monster customer?
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇餐厅经理]
虽然长得吓人，可魔物也能是本餐厅的顾客。
魔物客人，您想点什么？

scripts.text:
[Airship Cafeteria Manager]
Ah... Argh! Help me!!
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇餐厅经理]
啊...啊！救命！！

scripts.text:
[Gambling Spirit]
Hey! Don't touch my cards!
Off with your hands and neck!
scripts.translation:
[赌博之魂]
喂！别碰我的牌！
小心我剁了你的手，砍了你的头！

scripts.text:
[Gambling Spirit]
Huh..?!
I was just getting a feel for this and these monsters show up?! Are you trying to steal my money because I won a little? Huh?!
scripts.translation:
[赌博之魂]
什...什么？！
我刚找到点手感，你们就冒出来了？！不就是赢了点钱吗，这就想抢回去？啊？！

scripts.text:
[Airship Crew]
This is the entrance to the engine room. Stop them from getting in!
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇船员]
这里是引擎室的入口。阻止它们进来！

scripts.text:
[Airship Crew]
Damn... There are too many of them! The engine room could get overrun!!
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇船员]
该死...它们太多了！引擎室要被攻陷了！！

scripts.text:
[King's Escort]
We must not waken our sleeping King no matter what happens!
scripts.translation:
[国王的护卫]
无论发生什么，都绝不能吵醒正在熟睡的国王！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
....Snore...Zzz

[Chaos]
Damn... They have already reached this far! Thanks to you the Rune Engine was defended.
scripts.translation:
[混沌]
该死...它们已经追到这里了！多亏了你，符文引擎才得以保全。

scripts.text:
[Iris]
Uh...oh!! There's a gremlin heading towards the engine room!!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
呃...啊！！有一只小鬼正朝引擎室跑去！！

scripts.text:
[Chaos]
.....!! We have to stop him!!
scripts.translation:
[混沌]
...！！我们必须阻止它！！

scripts.text:
[Gremlin]
Squeak..!!
- Pop! Pop pop!
scripts.translation: - 砰！砰砰！

scripts.text:
[Iris]
Eeek!!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
呀！！

scripts.text:
[Crew Member]
Argh! The Rune Engine!! The engine room has exploded!! Fire suppression team! Put out the fire!!
scripts.translation:
[船员]
啊！符文引擎！！引擎室爆炸了！！消防队！快灭火！！

scripts.text:
[Chaos]
Damn it!! It's dangerous here! Let's get out of here first! Iris, hurry!!
scripts.translation:
[混沌]
该死！！这里太危险了！先撤出去！艾莉丝，快！！

scripts.text:
[Traveling Knight]
Ah.. Argh!!
It's going to explode! Have to go over... I have to go over to that Airship on the other side!!
scripts.translation:
[游历的骑士]
啊...啊！！
要爆炸了！得过去...我必须去对面那艘飞空艇！！

scripts.text:
[Free Riding Bard]
Whoa... Gorgeous~ Fantastic~
Even the exploding ship is incredible~ Whoa~
scripts.translation:
[搭便车的诗人]
哇...好壮观~ 太精彩了~
连飞空艇爆炸都这么不可思议~ 哇~

scripts.text:
[Gambling Spirit]
What is this? Fire?
Ahhhhhh~
scripts.translation:
[赌博之魂]
这是什么？火？
啊啊啊啊~

scripts.text:
[Airship Cafeteria Manager]
Is this ship.. going to fall..
However I will share fate with this ship. This ship and I are one!
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇餐厅经理]
这艘船...要坠毁了吗...
不过，我要和这艘船共存亡。
我和这艘船是一体的！

scripts.text:
[Airship Cafeteria Manager]
Ah... Argh! Help me!!
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇餐厅经理]
啊...啊！救命！！

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
...These bastards just keep coming.
scripts.translation:
[芬里尔]
...这群混蛋没完没了。

scripts.text:
[?????]
As expected. Our intuition wasn't wrong. It was fruitful to have followed the wave of evil and come this far.
scripts.translation:
[?????]
果然，我们的直觉没错。
追着邪恶的波动来到这里，果然有所收获。

scripts.text:
[Iris]
...?? Who goes there!!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
...？？是谁在那里！！

scripts.text:
[?????]
Let me introduce...
scripts.translation:
[?????]
请允许我们自我介绍...

scripts.text:
[?????]
Shiva! Basara! Laksmi!
We are the invincible Rangers!
scripts.translation:
[?????]
湿婆！婆娑罗！拉克什米！
我们就是无敌战队！

scripts.text:
[Guardian Heroines]
Guardian Heroines!!
scripts.translation:
[守护女英雄]
守护女英雄！！

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
......

[Shiva]
Hm? What's with the reaction? Everybody is kind of a lukewarm... Was it too much?
scripts.translation:
[湿婆]
嗯？怎么这个反应？大家好像都挺冷淡的...是不是太夸张了？

scripts.text:
[Basara]
Hm, no, no. Everybody is just captivated by our great entrance.
scripts.translation:
[婆娑罗]
嗯，不不不。大家只是被我们华丽的登场迷住了。

scripts.text:
[Laksmi]
Right, right. This much production for a hero's entrance is a bit too much!!
scripts.translation:
[拉克什米]
对啊对啊，英雄登场弄出这么大的排场，确实有点过头了！！

scripts.text:
[Iris]
Pu....
Puhahahahahahahahaha
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
噗...
噗哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈

scripts.text:
[Iris]
What? Who are these idiots?!
Just look at their clothes!!
Are those stage costumes? Are they celebrities and not heroes?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
什么啊？这些笨蛋是谁？！
瞧瞧她们穿的衣服！！那是演出服吗？她们到底是英雄还是明星啊？

scripts.text:
[Shiva]
Humph. You don't know what you're talking about!
Do you know how much these clothes cost? That is what's wrong with people who are dull to the latest fashion~
scripts.translation:
[湿婆]
哼，你根本不懂！
你知道这身衣服花了多少钱吗？跟不上潮流的人就是这样~

scripts.text:
[Basara]
You guys! This isn't the time to be chatting like this! Let's root out the wave of evil!!
scripts.translation:
[婆娑罗]
你们！现在不是闲聊的时候！让我们铲除邪恶的波动吧！！

scripts.text:
[Shiva]
Roger, Basara! Let's end it with a swift attack!!
Huuma Metal Shuriken!! Hiyah!
scripts.translation:
[湿婆]
收到，婆娑罗！速战速决！！
风魔金属手里剑！！嘿呀！

scripts.text: - Pop! Pop pop!
scripts.translation: - 砰！砰砰！

scripts.text:
[Iris]
What, what are they... Absolute morons...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
她、她们在干什么...一群大笨蛋...

scripts.text:
[Arcana]
Oh? Gee!
An unexpected ally?
This could turn out to be a fun party~
scripts.translation:
[阿尔卡纳]
哦？哎呀！
意想不到的盟友？
这可能会变成一场有趣的派对~

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
Wait!
It would be better to end this party now... What is this? Did Freyja send you?
scripts.translation:
[芬里尔]
等等！这场派对也该结束了...
怎么回事？是弗蕾雅派你来的？

scripts.text:
[Arcana]
Oh. You have no fear.
How dare a mere lowly human say Freyja's name.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔卡纳]
哦，胆子不小啊。
区区低贱的人类，也敢直呼弗蕾雅的名讳。

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
As expected. You are Freyja's pawn?
scripts.translation:
[芬里尔]
果然。你是弗蕾雅的棋子？

scripts.text:
[Arcana]
...Careful. If you keep going on like that...
You will receive a divine punishment!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔卡纳]
...说话小心点。
再敢胡言乱语...当心神罚！

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
...!!

[Arcana]
Okay~ I will show you something good. Something to cool your heads.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔卡纳]
好吧~给你们看点好东西，帮你们冷静冷静。

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
Could it be... Wyvern's Breath?!!
scripts.translation:
[芬里尔]
难道说...是双足飞龙的吐息？！！

scripts.text:
[Arcana]
B.I.N.G.O. ~
scripts.translation:
[阿尔卡纳]
答对了~

scripts.text:
[Wyvern]
Wooooo..!!
scripts.translation:
[双足飞龙]
嗷呜呜...！！

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
No... no!! The ship!!
scripts.translation:
[芬里尔]
不...不！！船！！

scripts.text: - Boom!!!

[Fenrir]
...?! Loki!!

[Loki]
Hm...
My new clothes are ruined...
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
哼...
我的新衣服都毁了...

scripts.text:
[Arcana]
Ooh.. you threw back Wyvern's Breath... an unexpected outcome. But can you withstand this one?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔卡纳]
哦...居然把双足飞龙的吐息反弹回来了...真让人意外。
不过，这一招你挡得住吗？

scripts.text:
[Wyvern]
Wooooo..!!
scripts.translation:
[双足飞龙]
嗷呜呜...！！

scripts.text:
[Loki]
Bothersome pests...
You! I will face one while you face the other...
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
烦人的家伙...
你！我对付一个，另一个交给你...

scripts.text:
[Gremlins]
Squeak... Kooar~!!
scripts.translation:
[小鬼]
吱吱...嘎啊~！！

scripts.text:
[Iris]
Eek! There are still more of these!!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
呀！还有这么多！！

scripts.text:
[Captain Felrock]
Found it! My weapon! Hehehehe
scripts.translation:
[船长 费尔洛克]
找到了！我的武器！嘿嘿嘿嘿

scripts.text:
[Captain Ferlock]
I will show you what happens when you attack my ship!
scripts.translation:
[船长 费尔洛克]
我要让你们看看攻击我的船会有什么下场！

scripts.text:
[Captain Ferlock]
I will end this with my specially manufactured Exodus Joker XIII Doom Rifle!
scripts.translation:
[船长 费尔洛克]
就用我特制的“出埃及记·小丑XIII”末日步枪解决你们！

scripts.text:
[Iris]
Just.. just a minute...
You're really going to fire that?!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
等...等一下...
你真的要开火吗？！

scripts.text:
[Captain Ferlock]
Of course!
Hehehehehehehehe!
scripts.translation:
[船长 费尔洛克]
当然！
嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿！

scripts.text: - Bang! Babang! Bang!
scripts.translation: - 砰！砰砰！砰！

scripts.text:
[Gremlins]
Urrrk!!
scripts.translation:
[小鬼]
呃啊！！

scripts.text:
[Captain Ferlock]
Muhahahaha!
How do you like that!!
Muhahahahaha
scripts.translation:
[船长 费尔洛克]
哇哈哈哈！
这下知道厉害了吧！！
哇哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text: - Bang! Babang! Bang!
scripts.translation: - 砰！砰砰！砰！

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Arrgh... the en..engine!
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
啊...引擎...引擎！

scripts.text:
[Captain Ferlock]
What?! Those bastards are breaking the engine more?!! You're making me angry!!
scripts.translation:
[船长 费尔洛克]
什么？！那群混蛋还在破坏引擎？！
气死我了！！

scripts.text:
[Iris]
You're the one who did it!!!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
明明是你自己干的！！！

scripts.text: - Bang! Babang! Bang!
scripts.translation: - 砰！砰砰！砰！

scripts.text:
[Captain Ferlock]
Bastards! Die! Die!
Muhahahaha!!
scripts.translation:
[船长 费尔洛克]
混蛋！去死！去死！
哇哈哈哈！！

scripts.text:
[Iris]
The way things are going the ship will crash because of that reindeer captain!! Stop that captain!! I'm scared...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
照这样下去，船会因为那个驯鹿船长而坠毁的！！
快阻止那个船长！！我好害怕...

scripts.text:
[Iris]
How can we stop him? ...Maybe he will regain his senses if you beat him just enough to not die... I'm counting on you!!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
怎么才能拦住他啊？...要不揍他一顿，只要别打死，说不定就清醒了...拜托你了！！

scripts.text:
[Chaos]
You get out of here now!! This ship is in danger!!
scripts.translation:
[混沌]
你快离开这里！！这艘船太危险了！！

scripts.text:
[Captain Ferlock]
Oops.. I was shooting like crazy. Looks like a lot of the Gremlins are gone? Hehehehe
scripts.translation:
[船长 费尔洛克]
哎呀...刚才打得太疯了。
好像消灭了不少小鬼啊？嘿嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Iris]
The ship is damaged because of you!!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
船是因为你才受损的！！

scripts.text:
[Arcana]
Doing our work for us. Hm, I guess this is enough?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔卡纳]
真是替我们省事了。
嗯，差不多了吧？

scripts.text:
[Arcana]
Then it's time for us to slip away...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔卡纳]
那么，是时候撤退了...

scripts.text:
[Laksmi]
Oh? ... There, Basara. Looks like they are retreating.
scripts.translation:
[拉克什米]
哦？...婆娑罗，看来他们正在撤退。

scripts.text:
[Basara]
Of course!! They got a sense of our skill!! Hohoho~
scripts.translation:
[婆娑罗]
那当然！！他们领教过我们的厉害了！！呵呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Basara]
On that note, one last Huuma Metal Shuriken!!
scripts.translation:
[婆娑罗]
趁此机会，最后一发风魔金属手里剑！！

scripts.text: - Babang! Bang!
scripts.translation: - 砰砰！砰！

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
Eek!! Looks like we'll fall!!
...too short... Can't reach...
scripts.translation:
[芬里尔]
呀！！我们要掉下去了！！
...太短了...够不到...

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
...is this the end?
...A place I can't reach like before...
Chaos...
scripts.translation:
[芬里尔]
...这就是结局吗？
...像以前一样，一个我够不到的地方...
混沌...

scripts.text:
[Loki]
...Grab on
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
...抓住

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
Lo...ki?
scripts.translation:
[芬里尔]
洛...基？

scripts.text:
[Loki]
What are you looking at? Here, come up...
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
看什么看？上来，快...

scripts.text:
[Guard]
All engines confirmed halted!!
We have to quickly escape!
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
确认所有引擎都已停止！！
必须赶快撤离！

scripts.text:
[Captain Ferlock]
Damn...
Everybody get on the lifeboats!
Board the lifeboats with the passengers being first priority! Release the lifeboats that have completed boarding!
scripts.translation:
[船长 费尔洛克]
该死...
所有人上救生艇！
乘客优先登艇！登满的救生艇立即放艇！

scripts.text:
[Chaos]
Wait!! There are still people remaining!!
scripts.translation:
[混沌]
等等！！还有人在上面！！

scripts.text:
[Captain Ferlock]
There's nothing we can do!
If we keep stalling the rest will be in danger!! It's too bad but we have done all we can!
scripts.translation:
[船长 费尔洛克]
我们无能为力了！
再拖延下去，剩下的人也会陷入危险！！虽然很遗憾，但我们已经尽力了！

scripts.text:
[Chaos]
But the remaining people are precious lives as well! You're going to leave them?!! Huh?!!
scripts.translation:
[混沌]
可留下的人也是活生生的生命啊！你就要这样抛下他们？！啊？！

scripts.text:
[Captain Ferlock]
Yeah, you are right...
On that note I will leave you to take care of the aftermath. I'm off!!
scripts.translation:
[船长 费尔洛克]
是啊，你说得对...
既然如此，善后工作就交给你了。我走了！！

scripts.text:
[Chaos]
Hey! Where are you going! Argh!!
I will catch you. I will kill you!!
scripts.translation:
[混沌]
喂！你往哪儿跑！可恶！！
等我抓到你，非宰了你不可！！

scripts.text:
[Basara]
It is not the time for us to be facing these trivial Gremlins.
scripts.translation:
[婆娑罗]
现在不是对付这些小鬼的时候。

scripts.text:
[Basara]
I can feel a larger wave of evil.
Let's leave these little ones to them. Let's go!
scripts.translation:
[婆娑罗]
我感觉到更强烈的邪恶波动。
这些小喽啰就交给他们吧，我们走！

scripts.text:
[Laksmi&Shiva]
Roger!! Ranger Flying form!!
scripts.translation:
[拉克什米与湿婆]
收到！！战队飞行形态！！

scripts.text:
[Iris]
Huh? Hey!!
Where do you think you're going after destroying the ship?!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
什么？喂！！
你们把船毁了还想跑？！

scripts.text:
[Iris]
If I catch you next time I will make sure you die!! Be nervous!! You got it?! Be ready, you yokels!!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
下次再让我逮到你们，你们就死定了！！听见没有？！
一群乡巴佬，给我等着！！

scripts.text:
[Guardian Heroines]
...yokels? (Rage)
scripts.translation:
[守护女英雄]
...乡巴佬？（愤怒）

scripts.text:
[Guardian Heroines]
The ones who denigrate and condemn the path of righteousness... We should mercilessly hand down righteous judgment, right?
scripts.translation:
[守护女英雄]
竟敢诋毁、污蔑正义之道...
对这种家伙，就该毫不留情地降下正义的制裁，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Guardian Heroines]
Die villains!! Huuma Metal Shuriken!!
scripts.translation:
[守护女英雄]
去死吧，恶棍们！！风魔金属手里剑！！

scripts.text: - Bang! Babang! Bang!
scripts.translation: - 砰！砰砰！砰！

scripts.text:
[Iris]
Eeek!!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
呀！！

scripts.text:
[Guardian Heroines]
Ahahahahaha!!
Serves you right~!! Let's go!!
scripts.translation:
[守护女英雄]
啊哈哈哈哈！！
活该~！！走！！

scripts.text:
[Chaos]
Iris!! Come here!!
Let's quickly find Fenrir and Loki and get out of here!!
scripts.translation:
[混沌]
艾莉丝！！过来！！
我们快去找芬里尔和洛基，然后离开这里！！

scripts.text:
[Chaos]
You get out of here now!! This ship is in danger!!
scripts.translation:
[混沌]
你快离开这里！！这艘船太危险了！！
